subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from gateway config mutation?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix changes Feishu's public config shape and may affect the model-to-operator config mutation boundary.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested preview config while preserving current boolean defaults, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

options.title: Only neutralize failed progress wording
options.body: Keep Feishu streaming boolean-only and reduce scary non-zero exec wording, which is smaller but still leaves no way to stream answers while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Permit `channels.feishu.streaming` through `config.patch`, which helps recovery but broadens an operator-controlled config path and still lacks status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested preview config while preserving current boolean defaults, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata is the strongest explicit owner signal for Feishu plugin policy, while xzq-xu and steipete are useful code-history reviewers.
